summary: Checks mode uses the gh pr view rollup and queries gh pr checks only at the full 100-context page boundary. Merge mode uses the already-read rollup without a gh pr checks query. Both modes apply CD-0228's common classification and reporting rule, including workflow-run and job reads, while non-Actions rollup identities and ordering remain unchanged. The staged poll interval, carried deadline, bounded slice and stalled-command retry remain unchanged.
title: The ci-wait PR rollup query follows the page boundary
